description.message: Warns before opening a site whose name imitates one you already know (bookmarks and often-visited sites). Fully local.

l_title.message: This address imitates a site you know

l_h1.message: This address imitates a site you know.

l_lead.message: The name is almost the same as one you know. It is a common trick to steal passwords.

l_reason_same_look.message: The two names look the same at a glance, but use different characters (for example “rn” for “m”, “0” for “o”, or letters from another alphabet).

l_reason_one_letter.message: The two names differ by a single letter.

l_note.message: Klin compared the name with your bookmarks and often-visited sites, on this machine only. If you continue, Klin will not ask again for this site.
